decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or
without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved
plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby
permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning
authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall: </p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(a) be
of purpose-made obscure glass, </p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height
of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that
form.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony,
roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific
permission from the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 6pt; line-height: normal;">The development hereby permitted shall be
carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and
documents: Site
Location Plan, Existing Floorplans (dwg no. 01), Existing and Proposed Elevations
(dwg no. 02), Existing and Proposed Elevations (dwg no. 03), Proposed Ground
Floor Plan (dwg no. 04), Proposed First Floor Plan (dwg no. 05), Proposed
Second Floor Plan (dwg no. 06), Reasonable Exception Statement.<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side to rear extensions; rear dormer; roof lights in front, side, and rear roof slopes (Demolition of attached garage)
